query: A book about a teenage girl who tries to contact the other side with a Ouija board.

results.title: The Healing Time of Hickeys
results.author: Karen Rivers
results.description: Sixteen-year-old Haley Andromeda would like to think she's just a normal high school senior, but during a disastrous time in her life, she turns to the Ouija board and tries to communicate with the Other Side, which only leads to further complications. Original.

results.title: Spirit of the Moon
results.author: John Boman
results.description: On one fateful night, someone has used dark magic and captured the Goddess that lives within the moon. Who has done this and for what nefarious purpose? And how is this connected to a strange little town called SOVEREIGN CREEK? Two mysterious strangers, MR AND MRS WELLINGTON, have arrived in town...

results.title: Night World: Daughters Of Darkness
results.author: L.J. Smith
results.description: "There’s something strange about the new girls in town. Briar Creek, Oregon, has never seen anything like the supernatural grace of Rowan, Kestrel, and Jade, three sisters who move into the dilapidated old house next to Mark and Mary-Lynnette Carter"--Publisher.

results.title: Degrees of Guilt: Miranda's Story
results.author: Melody Carlson
results.description: High school senior Miranda Sanchez wants to change her boring life and, despite the concerns of her friend Sammy, she decides to become a "wild child," until her partying ends up in disaster.

results.author: Louise Fitzhugh
